page.overview:
Who is Orbital 7?

Orbital 7 is a character appearing in Yu-Gi-Oh! D Team ZEXAL. He is Kaito Tenjo's personal servant.

Haruto attended to the opening of the Duel Team Carnival along with Orbital 7 to watch Kaito Duel and cheer him on. Kaito was against Haruto being there, and yelled at Orbital, with Orbital apologizing.

When the Litterbots go crazy, Orbital detects the radio waves which were manipulating the Litterbots being broadcast from three points around the Tournament Grounds. He then leads Team ZEXAL to those points in order to stop the signals and return the Litterbots to normal.
